critique: The render has a clean black background and a centered pink, softly glowing particle orb with white spark detail, which reads broadly magical. However, it is very small and visually almost identical between frames 1 and 4: the effect reads as a static pink puff rather than the active, airy Light and Magic-style magical particle motion implied by the preset. The dense soft pink core also obscures the individual spark structure.

suggestions.why: Add outward motion so the particle cluster visibly evolves between frames instead of remaining a nearly static orb.
Increase primary particle lifetime so the new motion produces a fuller, more legible magical trail/cloud rather than disappearing immediately.
Reduce the opaque pink core so the brighter white spark particles and evolving magical structure remain visible.
